segments.narration: What if you could harness AI's power without drowning in digital clutter?
segments.screenAction: Split screen showing messy desktop with multiple apps vs clean minimalist interface
segments.expectedResult: Viewer feels intrigued by the possibility of AI without overwhelm
segments.visualPurpose: Immediately presents the core tension between AI capability and digital minimalism

segments.narration: Open-source AI tools offer powerful alternatives without the bloat.
segments.screenAction: Quick montage of popular open-source AI tools with clean interfaces
segments.expectedResult: Viewer understands open-source AI as a viable minimalist option
segments.visualPurpose: Establishes the solution to the problem posed in the hook

segments.narration: The secret? Focus on tools that do one thing exceptionally well.
segments.screenAction: Zoom into a single, focused AI tool interface with minimal features
segments.expectedResult: Viewer grasps the minimalist approach to tool selection
segments.visualPurpose: Introduces the core principle of the minimalist approach

segments.narration: Start with text generation using lightweight models like GPT4All.
segments.screenAction: Demonstration of GPT4All running on a clean interface
segments.expectedResult: Viewer sees how powerful text generation can be without heavy software
segments.visualPurpose: First concrete example of minimalist AI in action

segments.narration: For images, Stable Diffusion gives you control without cloud subscriptions.
segments.screenAction: Local Stable Diffusion interface generating images with minimal UI
segments.expectedResult: Viewer understands local AI image generation as a privacy-conscious option
segments.visualPurpose: Shows another powerful tool that respects digital minimalism

segments.narration: This approach gives you AI power without the digital baggage.
segments.screenAction: Clean workspace with just three essential AI tools running
segments.expectedResult: Viewer feels empowered to implement their own minimalist AI setup
segments.visualPurpose: Demonstrates the successful implementation of the approach

segments.narration: Choose tools that serve you, not the other way around.
segments.screenAction: Final shot of minimalist workspace with a subtle 'AI enabled' indicator
segments.expectedResult: Viewer feels motivated to curate their own digital AI experience
segments.visualPurpose: Leaves viewer with a clear call to action for their own digital minimalism
